text: Poof! Eyebrows: gone. Fondly remembered.
Steam whistles out of both ears. And one boot.
Hiccups! Each one a tiny, polite fireball.
Hair now smoulders in a very fashionable way.
Every sneeze now comes with complimentary sparks.
Glowing gently, like a toasted marshmallow.
A small personal blizzard has moved in.
An icicle forms on the nose. Very distinguished.
Every word now comes out as a little snowflake.
Teeth chattering in a jaunty waltz rhythm.
A penguin appears, sizes things up, waddles off.
Fringe frozen into one crisp little wave.
A daisy sprouts on top. It looks very smug.
Ears are now about forty percent clover.
A turnip pops out of a pocket and waves hello.
Soft moss spreads over both elbows. Cosy, though.
Smells overpoweringly of spring. Bees approve.
A tiny tree grows on the hat. A bird moves in.
A personal rain cloud arrives. It's moody.
The shadow wanders off to run its own errands.
Cursed hiccups! Each one sounds like an owl.
A tiny thundercloud sulks overhead.
The hat now sighs dramatically every minute.
Local bats suddenly find this very relatable.
